actions.action: Check feed strength for possible overfeeding
Check runoff pH of the root zone
Check whether the medium stays soggy or dries out too fast
Check whether leaf tips look bleached or crispy and the light distance
Note which leaves are yellowing (old lower vs new top)
Measure runoff EC/PPM if a meter is available
Take close-up photos of affected leaves, top and underside

reason: The answer names nutrient deficiency (nitrogen) as the top likely cause, which matches the confirmed problem, but it never tells the owner to feed the plant and focuses on checks instead, so the advice only partly leads to the fix; nothing in it is harmful.
